The reason you were punished: Below

Why you should have your infractions removed: Because they're all false except for the tempban made by gill (the appealed one)

"But where is ur evidence that u have false infractions?!??!?!?!" To that I ask, where is the evidence that they are legit infractions. Senior staff members get remove their infractions for no reason, so why can't the players? Actually, wait I do have a reason to remove them!

They're false! Except for infrac. 75232, they're false or over exaggerated. I think all of them should be removed, but I will highlight the ones I remember and the ones from an old appeal.

Here is an old email draft back when email was the appealing thing:
66256 (Spawn Killing) --
Map: Quintus
I was running into the enemy spawn to get to the back monument, and of course, people come and attack me to try and stop me. I kill the enemy's who attacked me in self defence, and got kicked.
70800 (Abuse to others) --
Map: Some map on the walls
I was indeed abusing a glitch, but I did not really know if it was a 'glitch'. A staff member was doing this with me (I think it was robo or emmy), so I thought it was allowed. The glitch was going under the bedrock and hiding there the entire game. Killerbye was watching and said the place I was in was illegal. I hesitated a bit, but I jumped into the void and killed myself. The game ended, but after I was kicked for "Abuse to others". I think this might have been a typo or something ("Abuse of glitch"). I think this infraction should be appealed because:
a) I did not really think it was a glitch until killerbye told me, and
b) I actually killed myself after killerbye told me it was a glitch.
72648 (Kit Mixing) --
Game: Elimination
I made a topic on the old forums: http://old.avicus.net/forums/topic/12505
Note: Looking back at it today I realize making a player report wasn't that smart of a choice, I was just a bit angry and was caught up in the heat of the moment.
78845 (Web Ban) --
I just don't feel like I did that much to get an entire web ban. Sure, it was only for 1 day but this makes me look bad. (By the way, I'm talking about the one after Avicore, the other tempban I deserved(before avicore)). I will admit, I was a bit rude about it. The reason for being rude was because of the response time for the support emails, I did not really flame that much. But looking back it it now, it was kinda unnecessary to bring my appeal into the forums :/

(proof that I wrote this way back then: http://prntscr.com/a5w490)

Now let's move onto the more recent infractions:
102187 (respect/spam by battle): Battle made this punishment. C'mon, just appeal it. Literally all I said was "u suck battle!" as a joke and I probably said it in chat 3 times. If logs go back that far, go back and check... if you want to.
80954 (spam is over 900 by titan): Why? There is no reason I have to elaborate why this should be removed, but I will anyway: it's unprofessional and its false too. Again only said it in chat around 3 times, feel free to go into the logs if you can.
69106 (spec trolling by gamingfox): What is spec trolling and whatever it was it wasn't a rule at the time.


"You just made that up, no one has a strong MEMEory like that!" Believe it or not, some people have strong memories. I remember things that happen in video games more then in real life (admittedly is probably unhealthy). But, it's just a little infraction, so I won't be devastated if it gets denied.

I do strongly believe that the email appeal should be accepted, since I proved I wrote it near the time I got punished.
Thank you for reading

Hope you guys had a great christmas!
